record.paper_title: Model Theory of Tame Valued Fields and Beyond: Recent Developments and Open Questions
record.original_question: Kartas proves implications from decidability of the positive-characteristic perfectoid-side fields to decidability of the mixed-characteristic fields Q_p(ζ_{p^∞}), Q_p(p^{1/p^∞}), and Q_p^{ab}. Can one prove a reverse transfer principle in the non-complete setting that goes back from mixed characteristic to positive characteristic, and more precisely can one strengthen the known argument so as to recover decidability in the language Lval(t) on the positive-characteristic side?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let p be a prime number. Consider the following p-adic fields in mixed characteristic 0:
- Q_p(ζ_{p^∞}), the field obtained from Q_p by adjoining all p-power roots of unity;
- Q_p(p^{1/p^∞}), the field obtained from Q_p by adjoining all p-power roots of p;
- Q_p^{ab}, the maximal abelian extension of Q_p.

Each of these is a (non-complete) henselian valued field of mixed characteristic (0,p). Via the tilting correspondence, each is associated with a positive-characteristic perfectoid counterpart obtained from the perfect hull of F_p((t)) (or of F̄_p((t))), regarded as a valued field in the language L_val(t) of valued fields with a constant symbol for the uniformizer t.

It is known that the existential (and full first-order, in appropriate settings) decidability of the positive-characteristic perfectoid side implies decidability of the corresponding mixed-characteristic field listed above.

Problem. Establish a reverse transfer principle in the non-complete setting: prove that decidability of Q_p(ζ_{p^∞}), Q_p(p^{1/p^∞}), or Q_p^{ab} (as valued fields in their natural language) implies decidability of the corresponding positive-characteristic perfectoid field. More precisely, strengthen the existing transfer argument so as to recover decidability of the positive-characteristic counterpart in the language L_val(t) (i.e., with a name for the uniformizer t).
artifact.status_search_result: The forward transfer (positive characteristic to mixed characteristic) via tilting is established by Kartas (Algebra & Number Theory, 2024). No published reverse transfer principle in the non-complete setting recovering L_val(t)-decidability on the positive-characteristic side appears in the literature; it is listed as an open problem in a 2025 survey on model theory of tame valued fields.

status_evidence.title: Decidability via the tilting correspondence
status_evidence.snippet: Relative decidability of Q_p(ζ_{p^∞}), Q_p(p^{1/p^∞}), and Q_p^{ab} relative to the perfect hull of F_p((t)) (resp. F̄_p((t)))
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the forward direction; the reverse is not addressed.
